tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the General conditions of eligibility are mentioned in bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a regular manufacturer/supplier/authorized dealer and shall have proven experience in the field of manufacturing/supplying of 11kv/above grade XLPE insulated armoured Alluminium / Copper HT cables of size 1000 Sq.mm OR above to any power houses/Power Utilities/Central Government/State Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Any reputed private organizations. In proof of the above, Purchase Order /Work Order and corresponding supply completion/Tax invoice/material acceptance certificate/payment receipt against supply of value not less than Rs. 55.28 Lakhs in a single Purchase Order/ Work Order (considering supply portion only for work order) issued in the last five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26) and the said documents issued from the competent authority shall be uploaded in e-portal (weightage of 10% per year will be considered for 5 preceding financial years to bring them to the present price level of financial year in which the tender is invited)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copies of Purchase orders/work orders

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder in the last five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26) should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual turnover of Rs.2.20Crore In proof, annual reports/turn over certificates duly certified by the Chartered Accountant shall be uploaded in e-portal and the figures in the uploaded certificate/document should match the UDIN online verification. (weightage of 10% per year will be considered for 5 preceding financial years to bring them to the present price level of financial year in which the tender is invited).
